name: Luxovius

attributes.attribute: a god of the Celtic mainland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Luxovius is a god of the mainland Celts. He is known from one inscription in France. The inscription stands at a healing spring in the east of the country. The spring was held to heal the sick who came to it. Only that one record of him survives.

okr.objective: Record the god Luxovius from the inscription that names him.
